description: This file contains helper functions for validating OFDM symbol indices and User-Plane PRB fields within the context of uplink control plane processing in a wireless communication system.

methods.name: is_symbol_index_in_cplane_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given OFDM symbol index is within the valid range for the specified uplink control plane context.

methods.name: are_uplane_prb_fields_valid
methods.description: Validates the PRB fields of User-Plane sections against the control plane context and logs any invalid conditions.
